overall_notes: This paper focuses on pivotal moment detection in conversations rather than traditional NLG evaluation. The NLG component (dialogue generation) is used as a tool for simulating possible responses to identify pivotal moments. Human evaluation was conducted but was limited in scale due to privacy constraints. The paper does not use automatic metrics to evaluate generated outputs, nor LLMs as judges.
